fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/lake-creek-campground ('No fees are required for this site', '$0.00 Pack In/Pack Out'; page last updated May 1, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'managed from Memorial Day through Labor Day, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'
4 sites with tent pads, tables and fire rings, able to take up to a 32-ft RV, plus 4 dispersed campsites. Roads and spurs gravel or native material.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/lake-creek-campground ('The campground has 4 sites all with tent pads, tables and fire rings and able to accommodate up to a 32' RV. There are also 4 dispersed campsites.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Pack in, pack out. The Forest Service page contradicts itself on drinking water: 'Amenities include potable water' vs 'Potable water is not available at this site.'

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/lake-creek-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Amenities include potable water and vault toilets.'; Water 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; '$0.00 Pack In/Pack Out'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Kootenai NF (Libby RD), ~32 mi southwest of Libby off the West Fisher Road, on Lake Creek at ~3,360 ft; stream fishing and day hikes. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 1, 2026) confirms free, 4 sites to a 32-ft RV (plus 4 dispersed sites), vault toilets; added season year-round (managed Memorial Day-Labor Day). Potable water (derived true) left: the page says both 'potable water' and 'Potable water is not available'. 14-day limit (derived) not on the page, left.
flags: Access-road flag: Kootenai alert 'Kootenai Flood Event & Inaccessible Areas' (start Dec 16, 2025, no end date) lists 'NFS Road 231 Lake Creek Bridge Washout at milepost 19.3' and 'NFS Road 231 West Fisher Road Washout at milepost 25.5'; Lake Creek Campground is reached by the West Fisher Road (NFS 231). Possibly inaccessible; check with the Libby Ranger District before going.
